newsitem.title: UK: Water companies welcome UK govt water "summit".
newsitem.headline: Water companies welcome UK govt water "summit".

text.p: The Water Services Association of England and Wales, which represents the major water companies, said on Tuesday that it welcomed the UK government's call for a "water summit".

"The time is right to look again at the future of water resources in this country. It is good news that the new government has taken the earliest opportunity to debate these vital issues," the Water Services Association said in a statement.
The Labour government said today it will hold a summit on water resources on May 19 in London, where it will put forward plans for action to tackle drought problems.
The water companies, industry regulator Ofwat, the Environment Agency and environmental and consumer groups have all been invited to attend the conference.
